chapter: The McShann band on the road and at the Savoy
title: 'Swingmatism' and the stolen band book
summary: Only one band arrangement, Scotty's 'Swingmatism', was recorded; McShann's book was later stolen.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But, Gene, one thing, since we're talking about McShann's records, as a result of these -- the popularity of these blues records, you never got to record all the bands' arrangements, did you?
Only one, that was Scottie's band thing, (unintelligible) "Swingmatism."
Yeah. Well, Jay told me that when he was inducted off the bandstand, that night the book was stolen.
Yeah, and for a long time, Johnny thought and I think he told Jay that he thought I took the thing. I'll tell you what happened there.
